title: RunRecord
description: One immutable measurement record. Records are append-only; never rewrite history.

schemaVersion.description: Additive-only evolution: bump to 2 only when required fields change; old records stay readable.

target.description: The repo/harness being measured. Hierarchical ids allowed: parent/child (no .. segments) — the store nests runs/ accordingly.

capturedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, set by the measure step; never hand-written.

wisdom.description: Which model/variant produced this run. Required when comparing wisdoms.

fixtures.description: Fixture-set label. Wisdom comparisons are only valid when fixtures are identical.

runId.description: Correlation id grouping records from one run.

propertyNames.description: Dot notation, lowercase domains, camelCase segments: runtime.lcpMs — see METRICS.md.

additionalProperties.description: Numbers for gradable metrics; booleans only for binary facts. No strings.

notes.description: Free text context for this run.
